title: Refresh loses selection
body: Clicking Refresh clears the selected row instead of keeping it.

title: Graph zoom jumps
body: Zooming with the scroll wheel snaps to a far zoom level instead of scaling smoothly.

title: Records filter empty
body: Typing into the filter box shows zero rows even when matches exist.

title: Annotate save fails
body: Save silently no-ops when a record has an empty slot value.

title: Profile chart clipped
body: The credibility chart's right edge is cut off at narrow widths.

title: Query timeout
body: A long-running FQL query hangs the results table with no error shown.

title: Browse tree slow
body: Expanding a large run directory takes several seconds to render.

title: Issue count stale
body: The open-issues count in the status bar doesn't update after a status change.

title: Nav rail overflow
body: The nav rail's last item is clipped on short viewports.
